pages.title: Seamless Contactless Check-In and Mobile Key Solution
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Revolutionizing Hospitality with Speeron NEXT’s Mobile Key Solution
 
Integrated directly into the Speeron NEXT platform, this feature provides guests with the freedom to bypass traditional front desk procedures by allowing them to check in, receive a secure digital room key, and go straight to their room — all from their smartphone.
 
The Speeron NEXT platform’s seamless integration of mobile keys is designed to be user-friendly for both guests and hotel staff, requiring no additional apps or complex downloads. Built with robust security protocols, the Mobile Key solution leverages encrypted technology, ensuring guest privacy and secure access. Speeron NEXT is compatible with a wide range of modern smart lock systems capable of supporting the required protocols, making it a versatile option for hotels of all sizes.
 
 
Key Benefits of Speeron’s Mobile Key Solution:
 
 
- 
  - No application download required: The Speeron NEXT Guest Experience System allows guests to use mobile keys without the need to download an app.
- 
  - Enhanced Guest Convenience: Guests can bypass the front desk, minimizing wait times and simplifying the check-in process.
 
- 
  - Touch-Free, Secure Access: Contactless key access enhances safety, while robust encryption protects guest privacy.
 
- 
  - Easy Integration: Works with popular smart lock systems and is embedded within the Speeron NEXT platform for a cohesive guest experience.
 
- 
  - Operational Efficiency: Reduces check-in demands on hotel staff, allowing them to focus on personalized guest services.

pages.title: Digital Signage - Speeron
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Effortless Digital Signage with Speeron
 
Our digital signage solution is built to simplify the way hotels and properties communicate with guests and visitors. Our user-friendly, cloud-based management system offers drag-and-drop templates, eliminating the need for complex hardware setups.
Beyond basic signage, we can integrate with our IoT solutions, allowing you to display real-time data from within your hotel or property — whether it’s energy usage, room occupancy, or other metrics. The system is scalable, making it perfect for properties of any size, and offers the flexibility of API connections for further customization.
With us, you can easily enhance your property’s digital communication and guest experience while staying ahead of the curve.

pages.title: Pite Havsbad Group Expands Speeron Partnership
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Pite Havsbad Group accelerates the digital guest journey in Luleå and Gällivare
We’re excited to announce that Pite Havsbad Group‘s new properties in Luleå and Gällivare have chosen to expand their partnership with Speeron through several additions to the Speeron NEXT Guest Experience System.
Across the two properties, the deliveries include:
✅ Guest Portal for TV & Mobile
✅ Online Check-In & Check-Out
✅ Mobile Key Integration with EVVA AirKey and Salto JustIN
✅ VisBook PMS Integration
Together, these solutions create a connected guest experience where visitors can access hotel information, complete arrival and departure processes, and manage room access directly from their own devices.
For the properties, this means more efficient operations and stronger digital guest communication. For guests, it means a smoother and more convenient stay from booking to checkout.
It’s inspiring to see hospitality operators continuing to invest in digital services that improve both guest satisfaction and operational efficiency while maintaining a strong focus on the personal guest experience.
A big thank you to Kristoffer Lundström and Tobias Lindfors for the trust and partnership. We look forward to bringing these solutions live.
The future of hospitality isn’t about replacing the personal touch. It’s about using technology to give staff more time to deliver it.

pages.title: Increase hotel upsell with online check-in
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Increase hotel upsell with online check-in
Online check-in is becoming an essential part of the modern hotel guest journey. Today’s guests expect a fast, seamless, and digital-first arrival experience, while hotels are looking for new ways to improve operational efficiency, increase revenue, and enhance guest satisfaction.
Speeron NEXT Online Check-In and Check-Out helps hotels streamline the arrival process by allowing guests to complete check-in before arriving at the hotel. Guests can verify their details, complete registration, and prepare for arrival directly from their own device, making the experience faster and more convenient for both the guest and the hotel.
For hotels, online check-in also improves operational efficiency. As much of the check-in process is completed before arrival, front desk workload is reduced, and staff can focus more on welcoming guests and delivering better service instead of handling manual administrative tasks.
Turning online check-in into a revenue opportunity
Beyond operational benefits, online check-in also creates a valuable opportunity to drive additional revenue through upselling.
During the online check-in flow, hotels can offer guests personalized upsell options such as:
• Room upgrades 
• Early check-in 
• Late check-out 
• Ancillary services and add-ons 
For example, a guest can upgrade their room, purchase early check-in, or add additional services directly during the check-in process before arriving at the hotel.
These offers are presented at a highly relevant moment in the guest journey and create a smooth and natural upsell experience that benefits both the guest and the hotel.
Real-time PMS integration
All guest selections and payments made during online check-in are processed directly in the hotel’s PMS in real time. This ensures that room upgrades, arrival details, and additional purchases are automatically synchronized with hotel operations before the guest arrives.
When the guest reaches the hotel, everything is already prepared, allowing hotel staff to focus on delivering a welcoming and personalized arrival experience.
Built for modern hotel systems
Speeron NEXT Online Check-In and Check-Out integrates seamlessly with leading PMS, including Oracle OPERA Cloud, enabling smooth, connected workflows across hotel operations.
The integration now also supports NOR1 upsell functionality within Oracle OPERA Cloud. This allows hotels to present real-time, personalized upsell offers directly during the online check-in process, enhancing both guest experience and revenue potential.
With this expansion, Speeron strengthens its Oracle OPERA Cloud integration by combining streamlined digital check-in with dynamic upsell capabilities.
Read more: Oracle OPERA Cloud NOR1

pages.title: Hotel express check-in 🔥 - Speeron

Santa’s Hotel Santa Claus in Rovaniemi, Lapland, is one of our customers that uses Speeron’s online check-in and check-out solution. With our solution, guests can check in online and create their own room key at the kiosk, as well as check out online and easily drop off the key at the drop box. Easy, right?
This helps the hotel handle all guests during rush hours and peak season, making sure there are no queues and also meets the needs of modern guests.
Want to know how it works? Check it out! 👇
